description: React component for configuring Text-to-Speech providers, including voice selection, credential handling, testing TTS output, and saving configuration within a chatflow application.

methods.name: resetTestAudio
methods.description: Revokes previous test audio URL, resets test audio state, and waveform reset flag.

methods.name: onSave
methods.description: Saves the current TTS configuration to the chatflow via API and updates state.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Updates the TTS configuration state with new values, manages provider status, and resets test audio on voice/credential change.

methods.name: handleProviderChange
methods.description: Handles switching between TTS providers, loads available voices for the selected provider.

methods.name: loadVoicesForProvider
methods.description: Fetches available voices for a given provider and credential.

methods.name: testTTS
methods.description: Triggers TTS generation API call, processes SSE stream of audio chunks, and sets test audio source.

methods.name: parseSSEEvent
methods.description: Parses server-sent events from SSE stream to extract event type and data.

methods.name: handleTestPlay
methods.description: Plays the generated test audio, triggers generation if audio not yet available.

methods.name: handleTestEnded
methods.description: Handles end of test audio playback.
